versions.changelog:
Healthcare Chatbot Pro 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Launches a production-ready healthcare chatbot with 24/7 AI-powered patient support.
- Automates appointment scheduling, patient query responses, billing/insurance FAQs, and reminder workflows.
- Integrates with major EMR (Epic, Cerner, NextGen, athenahealth) and CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive) systems.
- Supports multi-channel communication including SMS/voice (Twilio), WhatsApp, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and web chat.
- Delivers HIPAA-compliant data privacy, security controls, and audit logging.
